task_instance: Created a small sample Node.js/Express + Mongoose 'todo' repo (with package.json, README, .env.example, src/index.js, src/db.js, tests/index.test.js, and 2 git commits) inside the work directory, then produced the skill's required deliverable: seven populated documents in docs/codebase/ (STACK.md, STRUCTURE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, CONVENTIONS.md, INTEGRATIONS.md, TESTING.md, CONCERNS.md), each with an Evidence section citing concrete file paths, [TODO]/[ASK USER] markers for unknowns/intent gaps, and an explicit Intent-vs-Reality divergence (README claims a layered architecture that doesn't exist in code).
evidence: Sample repo built at sample-project/ with git history (2 commits) so churn analysis was possible. The skill's bundled scripts/scan.py, references/, and assets/templates/ were NOT present in the skill source directory (only SKILL.md and LICENSE existed there), so the 'scan' step was performed manually with equivalent shell/git commands run from sample-project/: `cat package.json`, `find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print`, `grep -rn 'TODO\|FIXME' --include='*.js' .`, `git log --format=format: --name-only | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn`, and `cat .env.example`. Using that evidence, all seven required docs were written to sample-project/docs/codebase/ (verified present via `ls docs/codebase/`: ARCHITECTURE.md, CONCERNS.md, CONVENTIONS.md, INTEGRATIONS.md, STACK.md, STRUCTURE.md, TESTING.md, 182 total lines). Verified each file contains an 'Evidence' section (grep -c 'Evidence' on each file, all >=4) and that [ASK USER]/[TODO] markers appear in 5 of the docs. No missing runtime capability was hit; the only gap was a missing bundled script/template asset in the skill's source folder, which was substituted with equivalent manual commands without needing any tool the runtime doesn't grant.
